Elon Musk Accuses Ambani, BJP of Blocking Starlink Launch

Elon Musk, CEO of SpaceX, has publicly accused Mukesh Ambani and the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) of obstructing the launch of Starlink, SpaceX's satellite internet service, in India. Musk alleged that powerful business interests are protecting existing telecom operators and shared reports linking Reliance, a company led by Ambani, to BJP campaigns and donations. He also posted a mock exchange with Prime Minister Narendra Modi, addressing Ambani as "Prime Minister Ambani" and apologizing for the delay. In response, actor and politician Kamal Haasan stated that India is a democracy, not a colony, and questioned Musk's remarks. Zoho Co-Founder Sridhar Vembu also challenged Musk's claims about license hurdles.
